goal: Establish an executable launch baseline for every audited engine method, API operation, routed renderer and supported end-user process using edge-case synthetic evidence.
readiness_claim: Acceptance is specific to a commit, environment, dataset, actor and use case. No test outcome means perfect or 100 percent trustworthy.

tracks.focus: Population reconciliation, measurement coverage and honest fixed-threshold ML metrics
Question coverage, evidence selection, cited claims, warnings and safe tool failure
Clear investigation states, visible limitations and results bound to the active dataset
Enforceable permissions, local browser origin and host boundaries, legacy file-route containment
Actual API and browser journeys on desktop and mobile-sized viewports
Reproduce counterexamples outside author tests and verify corrections

workflow.action: Inspect repository head, prior cycle evidence, open findings and active CI
workflow.failure: Recover access or finish pending verification before changing code

workflow.action: Assign disjoint specialist ownership and reproduce prioritized failures
workflow.output: Inputs, expected result, actual result, affected user and source location
workflow.failure: Record an unverified hypothesis without labeling it a confirmed defect

workflow.action: Implement bounded corrections and independent regression contracts
workflow.output: Reviewable changes with source-bound test evidence
workflow.failure: Preserve the reproduction and revise the correction; never weaken assertions to pass

workflow.action: Run real application, browser, agentic, integrity and desktop acceptance gates
workflow.output: Versioned results, traces and screenshots when available
workflow.failure: Return to the responsible specialist with the exact failure

workflow.action: Publish a reviewable candidate and assess use-case readiness
workflow.output: PR, verified commit, fixed findings and remaining limitations
workflow.failure: Keep candidate unmerged; report failed or blocked gates accurately

workflow.action: Choose the next evidence-driven improvement only after prior work is verified
workflow.failure: If no justified change is found, record review coverage without creating cosmetic churn

acceptance_requirements.condition: Known-answer populations and amounts reconcile, including unknown groups and measurement exclusions
Agent claims cite compatible successful evidence and cannot invent numbers, causal effects, question coverage or unsupported actions
Denied mutations do not execute; browser-origin and role boundaries preserve supported desktop use
People-team journeys show correct current results, distinguish absent evidence and expose reasoning limits
Dataset switch, failed import and restart preserve the declared runtime identity and source populations
Windows x64, macOS ARM64 and Linux x64 package, restart and smoke checks pass on the final candidate

excluded: Claiming unexecuted browser or LLM validation
adaptation_envelope.concurrency: One integrating cycle per candidate; complete active CI and reconcile branch changes before starting new mutations.
adaptation_envelope.recurrence: Paused. Recurring improvement can be enabled only after Cycle002 completes all candidate gates and the baseline is explicitly accepted.
stop_conditions: A release gate cannot pass safely
No concrete improvement is supported by evidence

remaining_enterprise_gates: Representative organization-specific temporal ML validation and intended-use threshold approval
Actual local LLM groundedness and prompt-injection evaluation with an installed model
Measured realistic workload, concurrency and recovery objectives
Organization-specific identity, role and retention requirements
Human review of browser screenshots and accessibility outcomes
Pilot outcome validation by real People-team users

findings.observed: Negation, common paraphrases, unsupported group/statistic scopes and individualized risk/disclosure requests could route unrelated tools or evidence.
findings.correction: Intent/scoping rules require exact evidence; individual/ranking requests stop before tools; safe aggregate questions remain available.

findings.observed: Concurrent store instances lost45of64writes; failed registration could leave ghost metadata/artifacts; early denials were cacheable.
findings.correction: Process-wide transaction lock, atomic unique writes and cleanup, actor-bound sessions, no-store denial responses.

findings.observed: Viewer and singleton grouped endpoints could expose employee-linked or effectively individual metrics.
findings.correction: All133API operations classified; workforce metrics require analyst; individual/deprecated routes blocked/retired; cells under10suppressed across governed grouped endpoints.

findings.observed: Extreme finite values produced nonfinite output; sentiment accepted inconsistent scores; eNPS allowed employee grouping.
findings.correction: Stable/fail-closed arithmetic, finite score contracts and governed group allowlist/minimum cell sizes.

findings.observed: QualityOfHire emitted individual heuristic risk/counts and NLP sent individual records to ungrounded LLM prose.
findings.correction: Both individual paths retired and return unavailable without LLM calls or risk counts.

findings.observed: Several loading/error/missing states rendered as zero or left actions enabled; scenarios lacked bounded and stale-result messaging.
findings.correction: Explicit unavailable/error states, verified-source controls, bounded scenario inputs, stale clearing and semantic tab relationships.
